title: Data breach notification timeline - what companies must now do
p1:
A company discovers customer data has leaked. The first question is usually: "How long can we wait before telling people?"

Many assume businesses can take weeks to investigate quietly before saying anything.
p2:
That is one of the biggest misconceptions about data breaches. Notification rules are shifting toward faster action because affected people may need time to protect themselves.

The surprising part? A company does not always need every detail of the breach before starting the notification process. Early communication can matter more than a perfect explanation.
p3:
In simple terms, companies must have a clear response plan: detect the breach, assess the risk, identify who is affected, and notify the right people within the required timeline.

The lesson for businesses is that data security is not just about preventing attacks. It is also about responding quickly and responsibly when something goes wrong.
